mapper.select: SELECT ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'RESTAURANT' THEN 1 END) AS restaurant_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'CAFE' THEN 1 END) AS cafe_count FROM admin_dongs ad LEFT JOIN places p ON p.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id AND p.category IN ('RESTAURANT', 'CAFE') GROUP BY ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area
